lessons: Loot nearby containers first only when no zombies are within about 3; a zombie at 1.7 range made looting container 2 deadly.
Eat when hunger passes about 0.3 and you carry food; each meal cut hunger about 0.16. Don't eat below 0.1.
Drink when thirst passes about 0.4; one drink cut thirst about 0.5. Never drink or eat when the stat is near zero.
Eat, drink and bandage only when zombies are about 6 or more away; all finished uninterrupted, even at 5-6 range.
Bandage when bleeding starts or hp drops, if zombies are not adjacent; don't keep fighting at low hp.
Flee when zombies are within about 12 and closing; if they stay within 3-4 after two or three flees, fight.
When no food or water is carried and stats are low, loot another container instead of waiting. Keep one water in reserve.
Unarmed fighting at range under 2 killed us (hp 100 to 1 in 12 s); with no weapon and zombies near, flee instead of fighting.
